events.title: The demo just got a lot more world
events.summary: We have updated and expanded the Bravers demo!Just install the demo and check out:A much bigger slice of the open world, with trade posts, quiet corners and places that would rather you stayed awayReworked balance that gives you more to do early on Stay in it as long as you like. Build the ship, lose a block or two in a fight, hire someone who turns out to be a liability, and keep going. We are on the way to release in January 2027, and we are around. events.title: Silence doesn't mean we stopped.
events.summary: Bravers is back! Sorry for the long radio silence - we've been heads-down making the game the way it deserves to be. Today we're happy to finally share the release date: January 25, 2027. Bravers is about your ship, your crew, and an underground world born from the Great Impact. Build your ship block by block, recruit a crew, fight to survive, and explore what's left of humanity below the surface. events.title: Bravers - Answering Community Questions #1
events.summary: Hello Bravers! 👏 Thank you, everyone, for trying out the Bravers demo! We hear your feedback and will implement most of them. We also got a few questions from our community, and instead of typing long text posts - we tried to make it in the video. If you did not check our video, please watch it now, like, and subscribe. And we will continue this format with some more specific questions and ideas. Be safe 😷 and be brave 🤎!

events.title: Bravers Developers Stream
events.summary: Happy festival everyone! We got a lot of comments and feedback after our stream on February 3. The day the Steam Festival started. But almost all of them were in English. We're very interested to hear feedback from players who don't speak English. On February, 6 at 3 PM (15:00) Moscow time (GMT+3) we'll be streaming in Russian. Around 4:00-4:30 PM we will have a short break and continue streaming in English. Connect on Steam and via our social networks. Be Brave and play Bravers!

events.title: Bravers Demo with Developers
events.summary: Happy festival! Our first live stream is scheduled for 3rd February, 7 PM PST. Join Roman and Alex, who will be playing Bravers, discussing the development and answering your questions. We will be streaming to Steam as well as our Youtube and Twitch accounts. Be Brave!
